rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for someone or something that cannot be defeated.

example.english: This team is truly unbeatable this year; they even beat last year’s champions.
example.traditional: 呢隊波今年真係無敵，連上屆冠軍都贏到。
example.jyutping: ne1 deoi6 bo1 gam1 nin4 zan1 hai6 mou4 dik6 lin4 soeng6 gaai3 gun3 gwan1 dou1 jeng4 dou2

rows.jyutping: mou5 jan4 daa2 dak1 jeng4 A
rows.note: Use this when stressing that nobody in the relevant group can beat A.

example.english: Nobody in this division can beat Ming; he is unbeatable.
example.traditional: 喺呢個級別，冇人打得贏阿明。
example.jyutping: hai2 ni1 go3 kap1 bit6 mou5 jan2 daa2 dak1 jeng4 aa3 ming4
